import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.font_manager import FontProperties
from matplotlib.ticker import ScalarFormatter
from pathlib import Path
import json, platform, math, textwrap

# Data and independent calculation
values = data["values"]
x = [float(row[0]) for row in values]
y = [float(row[1]) for row in values]
n = len(values)
mean_x = statistics.mean(x)
mean_y = statistics.mean(y)
num = sum((a-mean_x)*(b-mean_y) for a,b in zip(x,y))
den = math.sqrt(sum((a-mean_x)**2 for a in x)*sum((b-mean_y)**2 for b in y))
coefficient = None if den == 0 else num/den
if coefficient is not None and not math.isfinite(coefficient):
    coefficient = None

style = data["plot_config"]["style"]
width_px, height_px = int(style["width"]), int(style["height"])
dpi = 300
figsize = (width_px/dpi, height_px/dpi)
font_size = float(style["font_size"])
font_name = "Noto Sans CJK JP"
fp = FontProperties(fname=font_path, size=font_size)
fp_title = FontProperties(fname=font_path, size=font_size, weight="bold")

matplotlib.rcParams["font.family"] = font_name
matplotlib.rcParams["font.size"] = font_size
matplotlib.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
matplotlib.rcParams["axes.formatter.use_mathtext"] = False
if "text.parse_math" in matplotlib.rcParams:
    matplotlib.rcParams["text.parse_math"] = False

fig = plt.figure(figsize=figsize, dpi=dpi, facecolor="white")
# Dedicated regions: title/statistics, data axes, caption, abbreviations
ax = fig.add_axes([0.105, 0.32, 0.85, 0.535], facecolor="white")

point_color = "#0173B2"  # colorblind palette first color
ax.scatter(x, y, s=48, c=point_color, edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.8, marker="o", zorder=3)

# Maintain raw values, with sensible padding only
xr = max(x)-min(x)
yr = max(y)-min(y)
xpad = 0.08*xr if xr else max(abs(x[0])*0.08, 0.5)
ypad = 0.10*yr if yr else max(abs(y[0])*0.10, 0.5)
ax.set_xlim(min(x)-xpad, max(x)+xpad)
ax.set_ylim(min(y)-ypad, max(y)+ypad)
ax.grid(True, color="#D9D9D9", linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.85, zorder=0)
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_color("#555555")
    spine.set_linewidth(0.8)

ax.set_xlabel(data["presentation"]["axes"]["x"]["label"], fontproperties=fp, labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel(data["presentation"]["axes"]["y"]["label"], fontproperties=fp, labelpad=12)
ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=font_size)
for lab in ax.get_xticklabels() + ax.get_yticklabels():
    lab.set_fontproperties(fp)

# Exact title and visible independently computed statistics in a separate region
fig.text(0.53, 0.955, data["labels"]["title"], ha="center", va="top", fontproperties=fp_title)
stat_text = f"n = {n}；r = {coefficient:.3f}" if coefficient is not None else f"n = {n}；r = null"
fig.text(0.53, 0.895, stat_text, ha="center", va="top", fontproperties=fp)

# Wrap caption and abbreviations while preserving every supplied character
caption = data["labels"]["caption"]
caption_wrapped = "\n".join(textwrap.wrap(caption, width=49, break_long_words=True, break_on_hyphens=False))
abbr_text = "；".join(f'{a["term"]}：{a["definition"]}' for a in data["presentation"]["abbreviations"])
abbr_wrapped = "\n".join(textwrap.wrap(abbr_text, width=61, break_long_words=True, break_on_hyphens=False))

caption_artist = fig.text(0.06, 0.215, caption_wrapped, ha="left", va="top",
                          fontproperties=fp, linespacing=1.25)
abbr_artist = fig.text(0.06, 0.065, abbr_wrapped, ha="left", va="top",
                       fontproperties=fp, linespacing=1.2)

# Draw and inspect
fig.canvas.draw()
renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
canvas = fig.bbox
artists = [caption_artist, abbr_artist, ax.xaxis.label, ax.yaxis.label]
bboxes = [a.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer) for a in artists]
[(b.x0, b.y0, b.x1, b.y1) for b in bboxes], (canvas.width, canvas.height)
# Rebuild with revised layout/wrapping
plt.close(fig)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=figsize, dpi=dpi, facecolor="white")
ax = fig.add_axes([0.105, 0.39, 0.85, 0.465], facecolor="white")

for spine in ax.spines.values():

ax.set_xlabel(data["presentation"]["axes"]["x"]["label"], fontproperties=fp, labelpad=10)

ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=font_size)
for lab in ax.get_xticklabels() + ax.get_yticklabels():
    lab.set_fontproperties(fp)

title_artist = fig.text(0.53, 0.955, data["labels"]["title"], ha="center", va="top", fontproperties=fp_title)
stat_artist = fig.text(0.53, 0.895, stat_text, ha="center", va="top", fontproperties=fp)

caption_wrapped = "\n".join(textwrap.wrap(caption, width=43, break_long_words=True, break_on_hyphens=False))
abbr_wrapped = "\n".join(textwrap.wrap(abbr_text, width=61, break_long_words=True, break_on_hyphens=False))
caption_artist = fig.text(0.06, 0.27, caption_wrapped, ha="left", va="top",
                          fontproperties=fp, linespacing=1.22)
abbr_artist = fig.text(0.06, 0.065, abbr_wrapped, ha="left", va="top",
                       fontproperties=fp, linespacing=1.2)
fig.canvas.draw()
renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
named = {
    "title": title_artist.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "stats": stat_artist.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "xlabel": ax.xaxis.label.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "ylabel": ax.yaxis.label.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "caption": caption_artist.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "abbr": abbr_artist.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "axes": ax.get_window_extent(renderer),
}
{k:(v.x0,v.y0,v.x1,v.y1) for k,v in named.items()}
# Final positioning adjustment
ax.set_position([0.105, 0.405, 0.85, 0.45])
fig.canvas.draw()
renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
final_bboxes = {
    "title": title_artist.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "stats": stat_artist.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "xlabel": ax.xaxis.label.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "ylabel": ax.yaxis.label.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "caption": caption_artist.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "abbr": abbr_artist.get_window_extent(renderer),
    "axes": ax.get_window_extent(renderer),
}
{k:(round(v.x0,1),round(v.y0,1),round(v.x1,1),round(v.y1,1)) for k,v in final_bboxes.items()}
ax.set_position([0.105, 0.405, 0.85, 0.435])
fig.canvas.draw()
renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
axbox=ax.get_window_extent(renderer); stbox=stat_artist.get_window_extent(renderer)
(axbox.y1, stbox.y0, stbox.y0-axbox.y1)
out_png = Path("/mnt/data/figure.png")
out_json = Path("/mnt/data/result.json")

fig.savefig(out_png, dpi=dpi, facecolor="white", edgecolor="white", format="png")
plt.close(fig)
